title: Choose Connor Husser's visual world
question: Which identity feels honest enough to be you and clear enough to sell local website work?

options.label: Local Member Ledger
options.lineage: local business directories, civic indexes, membership ledgers
options.thesis: A signed public record of who Connor helps, what he makes, and what the owner receives.
options.viewport: A large Connor Husser masthead sits beside a numbered service record, proof index, and direct project inquiry.
options.risk: It can feel bureaucratic unless Connor's signature, photograph, and plain voice keep it personal.

options.label: Seeded Identity
options.thesis: Every project begins with a few real business facts that tune the identity around them.
options.case: Memorable and flexible, but the live system risks making Connor look like a technology experiment instead of a trusted local partner.
options.viewport: Connor's name and offer sit beside a living mark whose parameters demonstrate how business facts shape the work.
options.risk: The mechanism can overpower the straightforward service being sold.

options.label: Signed Practice Sheet
options.thesis: The portfolio shows skill developing honestly from family work to concepts to local commissions.
options.case: It makes the early stage transparent, but its childhood-learning association weakens professional authority.
options.viewport: Connor's name leads a sequence of increasingly ambitious project bands, ending with a dated personal signature.
options.risk: The metaphor can read handmade or young when the offer needs competence and speed.

options.label: Six-Point Check
options.thesis: A business's online presence becomes six calm checks that show what is working and what needs attention.
options.case: The free review becomes tangible and clear, but aviation language is unfamiliar to most local owners.
options.viewport: Connor's offer sits above six ranked gauges that summarize clarity, trust, contact, mobile use, ownership, and search foundations.
options.risk: The dark technical cockpit may make a simple local service feel specialized or severe.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A familiar personal portfolio with selected work, services, biography, and a contact action.
canonCard.viewport: A large personal headline, one featured website mockup, service summary, and contact button.
canonCard.risk: It is immediately understandable but gives people little reason to remember Connor specifically.
